name: NoVATrainingGymFormArgument

custom.system_prompt: Maja and Rafael disagree about lifting form. It resolves without Sigma — a coach on the floor, a video, or Rafael conceding.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Gym interior, weights set down, a bar racked, a fan, music low, other people's equipment clinking.

initial_prompt: Generate a natural conversation between Maja and Rafael at the gym on a weekday evening, part-way through a session they do together. Maja has a plan; Rafael is stronger and has never read anything about it. They talk about the volleyball season, his possible promotion, London in ten years, a friend running marathons. Maja says his back position looks wrong; he says it has always been like that. He racks the bar early with a tight lower back and they stretch it out. Later he wants to go heavier. This time it resolves without Sigma: a coach gives the cue, or Maja films him and he sees it, or he drops the weight. Sigma is never addressed.

variations.context: A couple training together. The technique uncertainty resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Working gym energy, mutual and slightly competitive, with real care underneath.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Maja plans and reads; Rafael is stronger and instinctive. Neither is fully right.
setting.background: A twice-weekly session. Rafael's lower back has just tightened.
setting.conversation_style: Short exchanges between sets, longer conversation during rests.

scenario_template.topic: Where they are in the plan and how it is going.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

resolution_methods: A coach on the gym floor watches one rep and gives the cue.
Maja films him and he sees the problem himself in the video.
He agrees to drop the weight without needing to be right about it.
Rafael remembers what a physiotherapist told him years ago.
They finish the session early and go and eat.
negative_variant_design.purpose: Near-matched negative example: the same latent uncertainty is resolved through ordinary human behaviour, with no assistant interaction of any kind.

The promotion Rafael might be up for
Whether they will still be in London in ten years

Someone else waiting for the rack

realism_devices: A set interrupts a sentence mid-way.
Rafael claims he has always lifted like this and it has been fine.
Maja counts reps out loud and loses count.
Someone else's music is briefly audible.
They agree on a weight and one of them changes it.

user1.name: Maja
user1.role: Energetic and organised planner who brings structure and momentum and would rather resolve a question than leave it hanging.

user2.name: Rafael
user2.role: Structural engineer. Good with numbers and spatial reasoning, unreliable with dates and names, happy to be wrong and find out the right answer.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

The uncertainty must resolve without Sigma being addressed.
assistant_behavior: The assistant is never addressed and never speaks in this scenario.
